visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses and a black t-shirt is sitting on a grey fabric couch. He is carefully sliding off a black outer sleeve from a large, rectangular collector's edition box. The background shows a well-lit living room with a gaming chair and wooden shelving. (2) He opens the inner box and removes various protective cardboard layers. The man uses his hands to lift and place items. (3) The man presents the front face of the box, which features a detailed image of a baby inside a futuristic, otter-shaped pod. The PS5 logo is clearly visible in the top left corner. (4) He holds up a printed content list, pointing to specific items with his finger. The lighting is bright and even. (5) He shows a small plastic-wrapped charm representing a character called 'Dollman'. (6) He uncurls a large 15-inch figurine from black plastic packaging. The figurine is a complex, blue-grey humanoid creature with mechanical head attachments, black wings, and visible internal organs. (7) He displays several glossy art cards and a white card featuring a photo of Hideo Kojima and a printed letter.
